mapper.select: SELECT EMPLY_SQ AS emplySq , EMPLY_ID AS emplyId , EMPLY_NM AS emplyNm , EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD AS emplyAuthTypCd , EMPLY_PW AS emplyPwHash FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE 1=1 AND EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId} AND EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD IN ('2')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EMPLY_LOGIN_TKN (TOKEN_HASH, EMPLY_SQ, PW_HASH, EXPIRE_DT, REG_DT) SELECT #{TOKEN_HASH}, EMPLY_SQ, SHA2(EMPLY_PW, 256), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{DAYS} DAY), NOW() FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD IN ('2')
mapper.select: SELECT E.EMPLY_SQ AS emplySq , E.EMPLY_ID AS emplyId , E.EMPLY_NM AS emplyNm , E.EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD AS emplyAuthTypCd FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_LOGIN_TKN T JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E ON E.EMPLY_SQ = T.EMPLY_SQ WHERE T.TOKEN_HASH = #{TOKEN_HASH} AND T.EXPIRE_DT > NOW() AND T.PW_HASH = SHA2(E.EMPLY_PW, 256) AND E.EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD IN ('2')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_LOGIN_TKN WHERE EXPIRE_DT <= NOW()
